import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import numpy as np

# Load and prepare data
data = files[0]['table']
x = np.array(data['raman_shift_cm-1'])
y = np.array(data['intensity'])

# Ensure 1D arrays for plotting/processing
if x.ndim > 1: x = x.flatten()
if y.ndim > 1: y = y.flatten()

# Perform IPBSA (Iterative Polynomial Background Subtraction)
# The default parameters are max_iterations=100, threshold=0.001, which match the request.
y_corrected = ipbsa(y, order=5)

# Save the corrected result for future use/reference
save_result("T039_corr_p5", y_corrected, x=x)

# Plot comparison
plt.figure(figsize=(10, 6))
plt.plot(x, y, label='Original', alpha=0.7, color='black')
plt.plot(x, y_corrected, label='Corrected (IPBSA p5)', alpha=0.8, color='blue')
plt.title("T039: Comparison of Raw vs. Corrected Spectrum")
plt.xlabel("Raman Shift (cm-1)")
plt.ylabel("Intensity")
plt.legend()
plt.grid(True, linestyle='--', alpha=0.5)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()

print(f"Successfully processed spectrum with polynomial order 5.")
